question: What installations follow on the back and head in this sequence?
premises: The three-principle installation is placed on the back reaching the three regions.
Then the installation of the eight Ghoras follows.
The head is constituted by their feet.
inference: After the three-principle installation on the back, the rite proceeds to the eight-Ghora installation culminating at the head.
uncertainties: The exact mapping of the three regions and the feet of the eight Ghoras is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: On the back, extending through the three regions, one performs the installation of the three principles. Then comes the installation of the eight Ghoras, with the head formed by their feet.
